subject: Payment charged twice
body: I see two identical charges of $49 on my card from this morning. I only subscribed once. Please refund the duplicate immediately, this is my business card and it's over limit now.

subject: Invoice VAT number wrong
body: The invoice you sent has the wrong VAT number, can you reissue it with IE1234567AB? Not time sensitive, just needed for our accounting.

subject: Cannot update card
body: My card expired and every attempt to add the new one fails with 'payment method declined'. Subscription renewal is next week.

subject: Refund still not received
body: I cancelled two weeks ago and was promised a refund in 5 business days. Nothing yet. I'm disputing this with my bank if it's not resolved today.

subject: W9 form for vendor setup
body: Our finance team needs a W-9 or W-8BEN form to set you up as a vendor. Whenever you get a chance this month.

subject: Downgrade not applied
body: I downgraded to the free plan last month but I was charged again today. I want the charge reversed and to stay on free.

subject: Upgrade proration question
body: If I upgrade from Team to Business plan mid-cycle, how is the remaining credit applied? Just planning ahead, no rush.

subject: Card declined at checkout
body: Trying to buy the annual plan, card keeps declining but the bank says it's fine on their side.

subject: Volume pricing for 200 seats
body: We're evaluating your platform for a 200-seat rollout in Q3. Could you send enterprise pricing and a security questionnaire?

subject: Trial extension request
body: My 14-day trial ended yesterday but the team hasn't finished evaluating. Can you extend it by a week?

subject: Unauthorized charge $500
body: Someone used my card details to purchase $500 of credits without my knowledge. This is fraud. Freeze the account and reverse it now.

subject: Suspicious login alerts
body: I got 6 login alert emails from Tokyo in the last hour. I'm in Chicago. I changed my password but sessions are still active. Is my data safe?

subject: Phishing email imitating your brand
body: Received an email pretending to be your billing team asking for card details. Reporting it so you can warn other customers. No action needed from me.

subject: API key leaked in public repo
body: I noticed one of our engineers committed a production API key to a public GitHub repo. It's still active. Please rotate and kill it now.

subject: Data deletion request GDPR
body: Under GDPR I request deletion of all my personal data and confirmation in writing. Standard process, no urgency.

subject: How do I export my data?
body: Is there a way to export all my projects as CSV? Looked in settings but couldn't find it.

subject: Bug: dashboard blank after update
body: After this morning's update the dashboard loads blank for all users on Chrome. Firefox works. Reverting to the legacy URL as a workaround for now.

subject: 2FA reset help
body: New phone, lost my 2FA device. Login with backup codes worked. Just need 2FA re-enrollment.

subject: Production down: all webhooks failing
body: Every webhook since 09:00 UTC returns 500 on our side. We're losing customer events in production. Need this looked at immediately.

subject: Feature request: dark mode
body: Would love a dark theme for the editor. Not a big deal but it would help us at night.

subject: Email digest arrives at wrong time
body: The weekly digest email shows up on Tuesday instead of Monday morning like the settings say. Minor annoyance, timezone Europe/Berlin.

subject: Cannot invite teammates
body: The invite button spins and nothing happens, tried two browsers. We're blocked on onboarding our new hires this week.

subject: Account deleted by mistake
body: Our admin accidentally deleted the whole workspace with 30 members. Can you restore it from backup? We cannot work at all right now.

subject: SSO setup for Okta
body: Following your docs for SAML setup with Okta, getting 'invalid audience' on login. Config XML attached. Can someone review our metadata?

subject: Double subscription on two accounts
body: My company paid for two seats of the same plan under two different emails. Want one refund and the accounts merged when convenient.

subject: Chargeback warning
body: Your charge shows as 'GITHUB SPECTER' on our statement and finance flagged it as fraud. We're about to file a chargeback unless you can confirm it's legit today.

subject: Discount for nonprofits?
body: We're a registered nonprofit, do you offer any discount on the Pro plan? Looking to migrate next quarter.

subject: Checkout page shows wrong currency
body: I'm in India but checkout charges in USD with 18% forex fees. Do you support INR or local payment methods like UPI?

subject: Renewal invoice for closed account
body: You sent a renewal invoice to an account we closed in January. Please void the invoice so it doesn't hit our AP queue.

subject: Payment failed but subscription active
body: My payment failed twice yet my subscription shows active and invoices show paid. Worried about a surprise suspension, please clarify billing state.

subject: Someone else's tickets in my account
body: I logged in today and I can see a stranger's project list and invoices. This looks like a serious data mix-up or a breach. Please investigate NOW.

subject: Remove card from closed account
body: Please delete the stored payment method on my old account, I don't want any accidental renewals. Whenever you process it is fine.

subject: API returns 401 with valid key
body: Started getting 401s from the REST API an hour ago with a key that worked fine. No changes on our side. Integration is degraded in production.

subject: Export file corrupted
body: The CSV export I downloaded is truncated after 100 rows, we have 4000. Need the full export for an audit next week.

subject: Competitor switching discount
body: We're on a competitor's plan and would switch for a first-year discount. Send over what you can do.

subject: Legal subpoena for account records
body: Our counsel needs your data-retention policy and records related to account #4482 for a legal matter. Response needed within the legal deadline of 10 days.
